thread:
ana: Last night's incident (span drop + mis-aggregation) had a couple of follow-ups we need to lock in. Recurrence pattern looks like similar ETL lag affecting rollups 3x in the last 10 days. Can owners + rough timelines call out?

liam: I can take the aggregator correctness fix (RDW-2345). Root cause looked like partial key sharding + late-arriving spans. ETA: patch + e2e test by end of week. Will need a short canary.

sara: I'll own the missing-span detection alerting (RDW-2346). Plan: add dedupe window check and a metric for per-partition span loss. Quick PR by tomorrow, then add to the oncall dashboard.

mike: I'll pair with liam on the canary config and rollout policy. Also opening a follow-up to check our prefix caching behavior that may be amplifying late arrivals (RDW-2347).

ana: @ops-bot can you post the incident timeline and logs link? (note: 'ana' is PM, 'ana' posted root)

ops-bot: Incident 1978123400 closed - postmortem created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PMTR-1978 - timeline and raw traces attached.

liam: Quick snippet of the aggregation query that undercounted after sharding change:
```sql
WITH keyed AS (SELECT trace_id, shard_id, count(*) as span_count FROM raw_spans WHERE ingested_at >= now() - interval '6h' GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT trace_id, sum(span_count) FROM keyed GROUP BY trace_id;
```
The bug was a join that filtered on shard_id prematurely. Fix will move aggregation pre-join and add tests for late-arriving span window.

ana: How likely is recurrence if we only patch aggregator?

liam: Medium — the detection/alerting and ingestion backfill are needed to stop the repeat incidents. That's why we split owner tasks.

sara: For detection I'll add two things: (1) a rolling compare of `expected_spans` vs `observed_spans` per service (~5m window) with a >15% delta alert, and (2) a per-shard lag metric fed to the dashboard. Simple pseudo-alert:
```yaml
alert: SpanLossDelta
expr: (expected_spans - observed_spans)/expected_spans > 0.15 for 5m
```
PR by tomorrow morning.

mike: I'll prepare a backfill plan for late-arriving spans and a safety net script to re-run rollups for the last 48h if needed. Estimating 2 engineer-days.

ana: Owners + SLAs summary?

liam: Aggregator fix RDW-2345 - patch + tests by EOW, canary 24h, full rollout next Tue.

sara: Detection RDW-2346 - PR tomorrow, dashboard + alert in 48h.

mike: Backfill RDW-2347 - plan by Friday, run after canary if we see missing data.

ops-bot: Reminder: recurring incidents tag added: observability/recurrence.

ana: Can we add a retrospective item to review the sharding change that introduced fragility? Assigning to infra-arch.

liam: Agree — I'll add notes to RDW-2345 and loop infra-arch.

sara: One more ask: include a short postmortem checklist item to validate rollup correctness after any shard/ingest change. I'll add to PMTR-1978.

mike: Quick check-in: any blocker for me to start backfill plan?

liam: No blockers from me. I can help with the sample dataset for emulation.

sara: I'll finish the alert PR tonight and ping here when dashboard is live.

ana: Great — let's reconvene on Monday for status. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

sara: Dashboard live and alert firing in staging. PR link: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/987

liam: Patch deployed to canary cluster. Monitoring closely.

mike: Backfill plan drafted in RDW-2347, starting dry-run tomorrow.

ana: Last note: log a post-check on the analytics pipeline after rollout (assign to oncall next week).

sara: Will add to oncall rotation.

mike: Dry-run successful, no regressions.

liam: Canary looks stable for 12h. Promoting tomorrow if no anomalies.

ops-bot: Incident recurrence watch created for 72h window.

ana: Thanks everyone — closing this thread pending full rollout.
